rules.name: PostgreSQL — Privilege Escalation via SET ROLE
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL SET ROLE attempts for privilege escalation
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "database" or Message contains "postgresql" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
